correctness.rationale: For c=(a-1)(b-1), Fitt_(a+b-1)Omega is generated by c-minors of a linear-entry Jacobian, so lies in m^c. The distinguished submatrix is z11*I_c, hence z11^c belongs. In characteristic zero, A_c=Sym^c(k^a) tensor Sym^c(k^b) is irreducible under GL_a x GL_b, and the Fitting ideal is invariant; its degree-c part is thus all A_c, proving equality. Direct semigroup exchange charts give each hypersimplex cone; counting Segre monomials gives colength L(a,b). The supplied checker tests finite cases; all quantifiers in the theorem are handled by the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The intrinsic Fitting scheme measures first-order failure of smoothness, a natural geometric invariant not determined by reduced point count. The global lengths for all hypersimplex toric varieties are exact, vary nontrivially in both parameters, and become substantially larger than the reduced number of points; for X_(3,6) the fat points have length 146 instead of 1. The representation-theoretic lemma works for every rectangular Segre cone, giving structural reuse beyond one special computation.
